teaser.en: Castor oil is among the offerings a man must bring to become an elder of Kaya Kinondo.
teaser.sw: Mafuta ya mbono ni miongoni mwa matoleo ambayo mwanamume lazima alete ili kuwa mzee wa Kaya Kinondo.

summary.en: *Mwono* is the castor oil plant, a large-leaved shrub of farm edges and waste ground. Its seeds give an oil for lamps and medicine, though the seeds themselves are poisonous.
summary.sw: *Mwono* ni mbono, kichaka chenye majani makubwa kinachoota pembezoni mwa mashamba na kwenye ardhi isiyotumika. Mbegu zake hutoa mafuta ya taa na dawa, ingawa mbegu zenyewe zina sumu.

about.en: *Mwono* is a fast-growing shrub, sometimes reaching small-tree size, with large leaves shaped like a hand with deep, pointed lobes. The leaves and stems are often tinged red or purple. The flowers grow in upright spikes and give way to spiny round capsules, each holding three glossy, mottled seeds.
about.sw: *Mwono* ni kichaka kinachokua haraka, wakati mwingine hufikia ukubwa wa mti mdogo, chenye majani makubwa yenye umbo la kiganja chenye pindo za kina zilizochongoka. Majani na mashina mara nyingi huwa na rangi ya wekundu au zambarau. Maua yake huota kwenye vishada vilivyosimama wima na hufuatwa na vibuyu vya mviringo vyenye miiba, kila kimoja kikiwa na mbegu tatu zinazong'aa zenye madoadoa.

where.en: It grows on farm edges and waste ground across the south coast.
where.sw: Huota pembezoni mwa mashamba na kwenye ardhi isiyotumika kote pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The seeds are pressed for oil, which is used in lamps and in medicine. The seeds themselves are poisonous.
uses.sw: Mbegu zake hukamuliwa kupata mafuta, ambayo hutumika kwenye taa na kama dawa. Mbegu zenyewe zina sumu.

culture.en: Castor oil has a place in kaya tradition. To become an elder of Kaya Kinondo, the main Digo kaya near Diani, a candidate must offer castor oil along with a black he-goat, a black hen and black cloth.
culture.sw: Mafuta ya mbono yana nafasi katika mila za kaya. Ili kuwa mzee wa Kaya Kinondo, kaya kuu ya Wadigo karibu na Diani, mgombea lazima atoe mafuta ya mbono pamoja na beberu mweusi, kuku mweusi na kitambaa cheusi.

names.en: The Digo name is *mwono*. Swahili calls it *mbono*, and Giriama *m'bono*. In English it is castor oil plant.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mwono*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mbono*, na kwa Kigiriama *m'bono*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *castor oil plant*.

reason.en: Another minor crop of farm edges
reason.sw: Zao jingine dogo la pembezoni mwa mashamba

reason.en: Another fast-growing plant of disturbed ground
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaokua haraka kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa

reason.en: Another poisonous plant of waste ground used in medicine
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wenye sumu wa ardhi isiyotumika unaotumika kama dawa
